title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information
title_zh: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver , a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0% and 42.0% with k = 10 k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过复用从过往交互中提炼出的知识来提升其性能。 然而，将新经验整理成一个随着增长而愈发有用的知识库仍然具有挑战性。 有效的知识积累应限制条目之间的冗余重叠，并确保新知识带来的贡献超出知识库已有内容。 但仅基于独立任务成功对采用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的训练者进行训练，即便重复了现有知识，仍可能强化通用指导。 因此，我们提出了 Knowledge Weaver——一种强化学习框架，用于训练语言模型从智能体轨迹中整理可复用的知识。 我们将受基于词元互信息（MI）的反馈与边际成功奖励相结合，以引导知识积累。 这些信号共同促使训练者保留经验中的独特信息，并生成在加入现有知识后能提升任务成功的条目。 独立任务成功奖励也有助于筛选出本身即有价值的条目。 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，当 k = 10 时，Knowledge Weaver 的平均成功率分别达到 54.0% 和 42.0%，比 GRPO 高出 16.9 和 18.7 个百分点。 在执行人固定的情况下，其知识库在 ALFWorld 的整体成功率和 WebShop 得分上也优于所评估的提示 기반 及现有知识库，包括人类编写的知识库。 我们的代码库可在 https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver 获取。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with external environments to solve complex tasks ( yao2022react ; gur2024real ; yang2024swe ; carl ) . Reusing knowledge from these interactions offers a route to agent self-improvement, allowing experience from previous tasks to inform future decisions. Prior work shows that high-quality, task-specific knowledge can improve agent performance ( wang2024agent ; li2026skillsbench ; ouyang2026reasoningbank ) . Such knowledge includes reusable workflows and executable skills that guide action sequences ( wang2023voyager ; wang2024agent ; yuan2024craft ) , as well as distilled lessons about environmental constraints and effective strategies ( majumder2023clin ; chen2024automanual ) . Stored in external knowledge banks, relevant entries can be retrieved and incorporated into the agent’s context without updating the executor’s parameters ( zheng2024synapse ; fu2024autoguide ) . This makes knowledge accumulation a means of retaining experience beyond individual interactions and supporting its reuse across tasks.

paragraphs.en: While these benefits establish the value of using knowledge, producing it reliably remains a separate challenge. Existing work relies on pipeline design or training-based methods for knowledge curation. Prompt-based methods extract reflective lessons, conditional guidelines, and reusable workflows from trajectories ( shinn2023reflexion ; zhao2024expel ; fu2024autoguide ; wang2024agent ) , then consolidate them through memory or playbook revision ( zhang2026agentic ; ouyang2026reasoningbank ; suzgun2026dynamic ) . Training-based methods integrate knowledge into policy improvement through skill internalization ( lu2026skill0 ) or the joint evolution of task execution and reusable skills ( xia2026skillrl ; shi2026skill1 ; yao2026skillrise ) . When curation is rewarded through downstream task success, this feedback assesses whether generated knowledge helps execution. However, these advances in knowledge construction and use leave a distinct question of how to train a curator to produce better knowledge for a fixed executor. Addressing this question requires considering both the utility of individual entries and what they contribute as knowledge accumulates.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些优势确立了使用知识的价值，但可靠地生成知识仍然是一个独立挑战。 现有研究依赖流程设计或基于训练的方法进行知识整理。 提示基方法从轨迹中提取反思性经验、条件性指导方针和可重用的工作流程（shinn2023reflexion；zhao2024expel；fu2024autoguide；wang2024agent），然后通过记忆或剧本修订进行整合（zhang2026agentic；ouyang2026reasoningbank；suzgun2026dynamic）。 基于训练的方法通过技能内化（lu2026skill0）或任务执行与可重用技能的协同演化（xia2026skillrl；shi2026skill1；yao2026skillrise），将知识整合到策略改进中。 当整理知识能通过下游任务的成功获得奖励时，这种反馈会评估所生成的知识是否有助于执行。 然而，这些在知识构建与使用方面的进展，仍留下了一个明确的问题：如何训练一个整理者，为固定的执行者生成更优质的知识。 要解决这个问题，需要同时考虑单个知识条目的效用，以及随着知识积累，它们所贡献的整体价值。

paragraphs.en: Building on this, we propose Knowledge Weaver , an RL framework that trains a language model as a knowledge curator to extract reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. A good curator should produce knowledge that improves task performance and adds useful information as the bank grows. Effective accumulation therefore calls for both limited redundant overlap and substantial incremental utility. Figure 1 illustrates these considerations through knowledge coverage over a task space. Optimizing only for standalone task success can favor general guidance that repeatedly covers the same tasks, yielding substantial overlap and limited additional coverage as the bank grows. Complementary entries extend the bank’s coverage, with the shaded region indicating the incremental contribution of a new entry. We therefore approach knowledge accumulation through both the distinct information retained across entries and the additional utility each entry provides.
paragraphs.zh: 基于此，我们提出了 Knowledge Weaver——一个强化学习框架，它将语言模型训练为知识策展人，以从智能体轨迹中提取可重用的知识。 优秀的策展人应当生成能够提升任务表现的知识，并在知识库扩展时添加有用的信息。 因此，有效的积累既需要减少冗余重叠，也需要实现显著的增量效用。 图 1 通过任务空间中知识的覆盖情况展示了这些考量因素。 如果仅针对独立任务的成功率进行优化，可能会偏好那些反复覆盖相同任务的通用指导，导致知识库扩展时出现大量重叠和有限的额外覆盖。 互补的条目可以扩展知识库的覆盖范围，阴影区域表示新条目带来的增量贡献。 因此，我们从两个维度着手知识积累：各条目间保留的独特信息，以及每个条目提供的额外效用。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge Weaver couples token-level feedback inspired by mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to preserve distinct information and encourage incremental contributions to the bank. The MI-inspired signal contrasts generation probabilities across trajectory contexts, assigning greater credit to context-sensitive tokens than to tokens whose probabilities remain similar across experiences. To reward incremental contributions, we measure the gain in task success when a new entry is added to retrieved knowledge. This marginal reward favors entries that improve execution beyond what the bank already provides. We also reward task success with each entry alone to encourage individual utility. These signals jointly train the curator, whose generated knowledge is retrieved to guide a frozen executor.
paragraphs.zh: Knowledge Weaver 将受互信息（MI）启发的词元级反馈与边际成功奖励相结合，以保留独特信息并鼓励对知识库的增量贡献。 受 MI 启发的信号会对比不同轨迹上下文中的生成概率，相较于在不同经历中概率保持相似的词元，为对上下文敏感的词元赋予更高的信用值。 为了奖励增量贡献，我们测量在将新条目添加到检索知识时任务成功率的提升。 这种边际奖励更倾向于那些执行效果能超越知识库已有内容的条目。 我们还会单独奖励每个条目所带来的任务成功，以鼓励其个体效用。 这些信号共同训练了策展智能体，其生成的知识会被检索出来以指导一个冻结的执行器。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether learned knowledge improves a frozen executor on ALFWorld, a household task environment ( shridhar2020alfworld ) , and WebShop, an online shopping environment ( yao2022webshop ) . Knowledge Weaver achieves success rates of 54.0% and 42.0%, respectively. These results exceed task-success-only GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points under the same executor. These gains demonstrate improved task performance and support a curation strategy aimed at reducing redundant overlap among knowledge entries.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents construct reusable knowledge through memory organization, experience distillation, and skill synthesis. Memory systems extract and organize information for later retrieval ( chhikara2025mem0 ; xu2026mem ; zhang2026nextmem ) , while experience distillation produces reflective lessons and generalizable strategies ( shinn2023reflexion ; zhao2024expel ; majumder2023clin ; ouyang2026reasoningbank ) . Structured representations include conditional guidelines ( fu2024autoguide ; chen2024automanual ) , reusable workflows ( wang2024agent ) , and executable skills ( wang2023voyager ; yuan2024craft ; zheng2025skillweaver ) . AutoSkill ( yang2026autoskill ) maintains skills derived from interaction traces, while Trace2Skill ( ni2026trace2skill ) consolidates trajectory-level lessons into transferable guidance. Skill-Pro ( mi2026skill ) uses execution feedback to generate and verify procedural skills without parameter updates. RL-based approaches further learn to use and construct reusable knowledge. Skill0 ( lu2026skill0 ) trains agents to internalize supplied skills, while Skill0.5 ( zhu2026skill0 ) combines general skill internalization with task-specific skill utilization. SkillRL ( xia2026skillrl ) couples skill distillation and library evolution with executor training. Skill1 ( shi2026skill1 ) jointly learns skill selection, utilization, and distillation, while SkillRise ( yao2026skillrise ) assigns curation credit through subsequent execution outcomes. Knowledge Weaver complements execution feedback with explicit information feedback to train knowledge generation while keeping the executor fixed.

paragraphs.en: Mutual information (MI) provides a general criterion for learning informative representations and encouraging dependence between related variables. In representation learning, Contrastive Predictive Coding captures information predictive of future observations, while Deep InfoMax promotes dependence between inputs and learned representations ( oord2018representation ; hjelm2018learning ) . InfoGAN uses MI between latent codes and generated observations to encourage interpretable factors of variation ( chen2016infogan ) . In reinforcement learning, DIAYN maximizes MI between skill identities and visited states to discover distinguishable behaviors ( eysenbach2018diversity ) . In dialogue generation, MI-based objectives discourage generic responses and favor responses that convey information about the conversational context ( li2016diversity ; zhang2018generating ) . AMI further models source-target dependence through adversarial optimization of forward and backward generation networks ( pan2020adversarial ) . For LLM agents, RAGEN-2 introduces MI-inspired proxies to assess the dependence of generated reasoning on input prompts ( wang2026ragen ) . In knowledge curation, input dependence concerns whether generated entries retain the distinct information carried by their source trajectories. Knowledge Weaver applies token-level MI-inspired feedback during curator training to encourage experience-specific content.
paragraphs.zh: 互信息（MI）为学习信息丰富的表示以及促进相关变量之间的依赖关系提供了一种通用标准。 在表示学习中，对比预测编码能够捕捉到对未来观测具有预测价值的信息，而深度信息最大化则促进输入与所学表示之间的依赖关系（ oord2018representation ; hjelm2018learning ） 。 InfoGAN 利用潜在编码与生成观测之间的互信息来促进可解释的变异因素（ chen2016infogan ） 。 在强化学习中，DIAYN 通过最大化技能标识与访问状态之间的互信息来发现可区分的行为（ eysenbach2018diversity ） 。 在对话生成中，基于互信息的目标能够抑制通用性回应，并优先选择能传达对话上下文信息的回应（ li2016diversity ; zhang2018generating ） 。 AMI 进一步通过前向与反向生成网络的对抗性优化来建模源-目标之间的依赖关系（ pan2020adversarial ） 。 对于大型语言模型智能体，RAGEN-2 引入了受互信息启发的代理指标，以评估生成推理对输入提示的依赖程度（ wang2026ragen ） 。 在知识整理中，输入依赖性问题关注的是生成的条目是否保留了其来源轨迹所携带的独特信息。 Knowledge Weaver 在知识整理者训练过程中应用了基于互信息的词元级反馈，以鼓励生成与特定经验相关的内容。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method on two benchmarks: ALFWorld ( shridhar2020alfworld ) and WebShop ( yao2022webshop ) . ALFWorld is a text-based environment in which an agent completes household tasks through sequential natural-language interactions. We evaluate knowledge banks on the valid_unseen split across six canonical task types: Pick, Clean, Heat, Cool, Look, and Pick Two. We report the success rate (SR) for each task type and across all evaluation tasks. WebShop is a simulated web shopping environment in which an agent searches for products, navigates product pages, and purchases an item that satisfies a user’s requirements. We sample 100 tasks from the test set to evaluate the knowledge banks and report both the environment score and SR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个基准数据集上对我们的方法进行了评估：ALFWorld (shridhar2020alfworld) 和 WebShop (yao2022webshop)。 ALFWorld 是一个基于文本的环境，智能体通过顺序的自然语言交互来完成家务任务。 我们在 valid_unseen 分割集上，针对六个标准任务类型（Pick、Clean、Heat、Cool、Look 和 Pick Two）对知识库进行了评估。 我们报告了每个任务类型以及所有评估任务的成功率（SR）。 WebShop 是一个模拟的在线购物环境，智能体在其中搜索产品、浏览产品页面，并购买满足用户需求的商品。 我们从测试集中抽取了 100 个任务来评估知识库，并报告了环境得分和成功率（SR）。

paragraphs.en: Throughout training, we freeze the executor and optimize only the curator. We assign equal weights of 0.5 0.5 to standalone SR and marginal SR. Token-level MI credit is scaled by 0.1 0.1 and capped at 0.15 0.15 after scaling. We use Qwen3.5-4B as the training model. After training, we use the trained curator to construct knowledge banks in a separate generation stage. We then evaluate the resulting banks with the frozen executor. Each knowledge bank contains 50 entries(except for SkillRL), with each entry limited to 100 words. To generate each entry, we randomly sample four trajectories from a trajectory pool. For each evaluation task, we retrieve the top- k k entries using the all-mpnet-base-v2 encoder ( reimers2019sentence ) , ranking entries by their cosine similarity to the initial task query. Retrieval occurs once, before the first action, and the selected entries remain fixed throughout the episode. We use k = 10 k=10 for all banks in the main comparison and evaluate every k ∈ { 0 , … , 15 } k\in\{0,\ldots,15\} in the scaling analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个训练过程中，我们冻结执行器，仅优化策展人。 我们将独立 SR 和边际 SR 的权重均设为 0.5 0.5。 词元级别的 MI 积分乘以 0.1 0.1，并在缩放后上限设为 0.15 0.15。 我们使用 Qwen3.5-4B 作为训练模型。 训练结束后，我们使用训练好的策展人在一个独立的生成阶段构建知识库。 然后，我们用冻结的执行器评估生成的知识库。 每个知识库包含 50 条条目（SkillRL 除外），每条条目最多 100 个词。 为了生成每条条目，我们从轨迹池中随机采样四条轨迹。 对于每个评估任务，我们使用 all-mpnet-base-v2 编码器（reimers2019sentence）检索前 k 条条目，并根据它们与初始任务查询的余弦相似度进行排序。 检索仅在第一次行动之前执行一次，且选中的条目在整个回合中保持不变。 在主比较中，我们为所有知识库使用 k = 10；在扩展性分析中，我们评估了所有 k ∈ { 0 , … , 15 } 的情况。

paragraphs.en: Table 4.2 shows that our method achieves the highest values on all three aggregate metrics with the same frozen executor at k = 10 k=10 . Overall SR reaches 54.0% on ALFWorld and 42.0% on WebShop, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points. On WebShop, its mean environment score reaches 66.4, compared with 49.0 for GRPO, indicating higher average reward alongside improved task success. Our method also outperforms SkillRise and Skill1 on both benchmarks. It exceeds SkillRL, the strongest ALFWorld baseline, by 2.8 percentage points in overall SR. Human-written banks achieve the highest baseline mean environment score on WebShop, but our method surpasses them on all three aggregate metrics. Gains over GRPO span five of six ALFWorld task types, although performance on Pick Two remains lower. These results support training knowledge curators with feedback beyond standalone task success.

paragraphs.en: In Table 4.2 , we evaluate strong general-purpose models as knowledge curators with the same frozen executor. Our trained Qwen3.5-4B curator outperforms GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Gemini 3.7 Flash on all three aggregate metrics. On ALFWorld, GPT-5 and Claude banks achieve overall SRs of 40.3% and 37.1%, respectively, above the zero-shot SR of 24.6%. On WebShop, however, their banks yield SRs of 18.7% and 24.7%, below the zero-shot SR of 27.3%. Gemini achieves the highest WebShop SR among these general-purpose curators (35.7%), whereas its overall ALFWorld SR matches the zero-shot mean (24.6%). These results show that strong general capabilities do not necessarily translate into knowledge that benefits downstream execution.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 4.2 中，我们评估了强大的通用模型作为知识策展人，并使用相同的冻结执行器。 我们训练出的 Qwen3.5-4B 策展人在所有三项汇总指标上均优于 GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.8 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash。 在 ALFWorld 中，GPT-5 和 Claude 的银行分别实现了 40.3% 和 37.1% 的总体 SR，高于零样本下的 24.6% 的 SR。 然而，在 WebShop 中，它们的银行产生的 SR 分别为 18.7% 和 24.7%，低于零样本下的 27.3% 的 SR。 在这些通用策展人中，Gemini 在 WebShop 中实现了最高的 SR（35.7%），而其在 ALFWorld 中的总体 SR 与零样本均值（24.6%）一致。 这些结果表明，强大的通用能力并不必然转化为对下游执行有益的知识。
